topics.about: which app in the repository gets the player: the marketing site, the dashboard, or both
topics.answer: The marketing site — that's the one customers see.

topics.about: how the library gets into the site, such as an npm dependency or a script tag from a CDN
how the player and its controls look, such as a fuller or more minimal style, colors, or size
topics.answer: No preference, whatever looks good out of the box.
